items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And about two weeks later, Gibson called me and told me the fellows wanted me in the band.

ctx.x: And about two weeks later, Gibson called me and told me the fellows wanted me in the band. And so I said, 'The fellows want me in the band, just like that.' He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Well, what happened to the drummer that was there?' He said, 'Well, something happened between he and I, just like that. And I said, 'Well, that's your business then, just like that.' Are you sure they want me in the band?' And he said, 'Yes, they want you in the band, that's why I'm calling you.' I said, 'Oh, okay, I'll come out and…
